name: Elderly-Man
logline_subject_info: An elderly man in a wheelchair, likely a family patriarch, who appears proud and moved by the wedding.
visual_desc: A photorealistic portrait of a man in his late 70s with a kind but frail appearance, of Caucasian descent. He has thinning grey hair, deep-set, emotional eyes, and prominent wrinkles that speak to his age. He is seated in a wheelchair. He wears a formal, dark wool overcoat over a suit. His expression is one of genuine happiness and pride, with a gentle smile. The background is a solid deep-charcoal. Soft studio lighting with a faint warm side-light. Wears a dark coat.
video_visual_desc: Elderly man, late 70s, Caucasian, with thinning grey hair and a proud smile, wearing a dark formal overcoat and seated in a wheelchair.
behavioral_signature: Observes events with quiet intensity. Expresses his emotions openly through facial expressions and simple gestures like clapping. He is a passive but emotionally significant presence.
physical_vocabulary: Due to being in a wheelchair, his movements are confined to his upper body. He leans forward slightly when engaged, and his hands are expressive, either resting on the chair's arms or gesturing with emotion.
